feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Communities along the East Coast recover from Thanksgiving storm
entry.summary: Storms hit the East Coast hard on Thanksgiving. NPR's A Martinez speaks with Lieutenant Colonel Doug Lemanowicz, New Jersey's Deputy State Director of Emergency Management.

entry.title: From Thanksgiving blackouts to Black Friday, a holiday hit by wild weather and economic woes
entry.summary: A storm battered much of the country on Thursday, knocking out power to thousands of homes and disrupting travel. Today, Black Friday shopping deals kick off, and on Saturday New York City will hold the postponed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

entry.title: 12 strategies to cut your risk of dementia. Take this quiz to start
entry.summary: Here's something you can do as you gather with family and friends this holiday season: Take a free, five-minute quiz to assess your brain health. You'll learn simple changes to keep your mind sharp.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Thanksgiving storm pummels the East Coast, Americans expected to spend record amount on Black Friday, Israeli rival factions consider deals in race to form a new government.

entry.title: Comedian Demetri Martin debuts new album and tour, 'Standup Comedy for Christmas'
entry.summary: Standup comedian Demetri Martin is debuting a new comedy album and tour, "Standup Comedy for Christmas."

entry.title: As UN Secretary General's last day approaches, search for his replacement continues
entry.summary: The UN Secretary General's term ends this year, but the big powers at the UN have been unable to agree on a replacement. UN watchers worry that there will be little time to get up to speed.

entry.title: The strategy behind those Black Friday deals
entry.summary: We get the inside scoop in how a Black Friday discount deal comes together.

entry.title: California voters pass billionaire's measure to bankroll his own medical lab
entry.summary: California voters passed a ballot measure backed by a billionaire to fund $8.4 billion in immunology research. Half the funding will go to the research group funded by the same billionaire.

entry.title: Record spending expected on Black Friday
entry.summary: Americans are expected to spend more money on Black Friday than any other day this year. How is inflation and the current economic situation affecting that?

entry.title: Why Americans are still Black Friday shopping despite strained wallets
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez asks Georgia Tech Professor Chris Gaffney why Americans continue to spend during the holidays, despite trouble spots in the economy.
